items.title: Ribbed Garden Leaf
items.alt: One broad oval green hosta-style leaf curves slightly upward, with strongly arched parallel ribs from base to tip and a complete thick petiole, no flowers or pot.
items.description: One broad oval green hosta-style leaf curves slightly upward, with strongly arched parallel ribs from base to tip and a complete thick petiole, no flowers or pot.

items.title: Round Shield Leaf
items.alt: One complete round shield-shaped nasturtium-style leaf has a petiole attached near its center, fine pale radiating veins and a gently scalloped edge, slightly tilted to reveal the attachment.
items.description: One complete round shield-shaped nasturtium-style leaf has a petiole attached near its center, fine pale radiating veins and a gently scalloped edge, slightly tilted to reveal the attachment.

items.title: Water Lily Leaf
items.alt: One broad floating green water-lily leaf with a clear deep basal notch, waxy gently rippled surface and radiating veins rests on a tiny bounded water ripple, no flower or pond background.
items.description: One broad floating green water-lily leaf with a clear deep basal notch, waxy gently rippled surface and radiating veins rests on a tiny bounded water ripple, no flower or pond background.

items.title: Raised Lotus Leaf
items.alt: One complete round lotus leaf with a central petiole attachment and gently ruffled edge rises on a sturdy curved stalk, tilted shallow bowl-like blade and clear radial veins, no flower or water rectangle.
items.description: One complete round lotus leaf with a central petiole attachment and gently ruffled edge rises on a sturdy curved stalk, tilted shallow bowl-like blade and clear radial veins, no flower or water rectangle.

items.title: Basil Leaf Sprig
items.alt: One short basil sprig with four broad soft green oval leaves in opposite pairs, gently cupped blades and fine visible veins, no flowers or kitchen props.
items.description: One short basil sprig with four broad soft green oval leaves in opposite pairs, gently cupped blades and fine visible veins, no flowers or kitchen props.

items.title: Mint Leaf Sprig
items.alt: A small mint sprig has three opposite pairs of textured bright green oval leaves with clearly toothed margins on a slender square stem, complete tips and stem end, no flowers.
